# orange&co

orange&co makes premium jewelry-grade timepieces, launching in limited numbered editions. This repository contains the code and configuration for the pre-launch waitlist landing page.

## Product Overview

**Brand:** orange&co (Orange & Co Timepieces)
**Category:** Luxury handcrafted watches / Jewelry-grade timepieces
**Market Position:** Premium accessible luxury — between fashion watches and high horology
**Unique Value:** "Time as a piece of jewelry" — watches designed with the meticulous precision of fine jewelry, produced in limited numbered editions

**Target Audience:**
- Watch enthusiasts seeking unique, limited-edition pieces
- Jewelry lovers who appreciate craftsmanship
- Gift buyers for special occasions (weddings, anniversaries, milestones)
- Collectors of numbered edition timepieces
- Pakistani luxury market + international shipping

**Key Differentiators:**
- Jewelry-grade craftsmanship (not mass-produced)
- Limited numbered editions (exclusivity)
- Gold plating & premium materials
- Direct-to-consumer pricing (no retail markup)
- Pakistan-based brand with global shipping

## Key Pages

- **Homepage / Waitlist:** https://orangeandcopk.vercel.app/ — Main landing page with countdown and waitlist signup
- **Pricing:** https://orangeandcopk.vercel.app/pricing.md — Machine-readable pricing for AI agents
- **FAQ:** https://orangeandcopk.vercel.app/#faq — Frequently asked questions
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/orangeandco.pk/
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61590506905194
- **Contact:** Orangeandco.pk@proton.me

## Business Model

- Direct-to-consumer e-commerce
- Limited edition drops (numbered runs of 75-150 pieces)
- Waitlist-based launch model (creates scarcity & demand)
- No permanent inventory — each edition sells out
- Worldwide shipping from Pakistan

## Launch Timeline

- **Current Phase:** Pre-launch waitlist building
- **Launch Date:** Managed via Supabase settings table (dynamic)
- **Edition Size:** 75-150 pieces per edition
- **Frequency:** 2-4 editions per year

## Competitive Landscape

**Direct Competitors (Jewelry-grade watches):**
- Nordgreen, Daniel Wellington, MVMT (fashion watches — lower tier)
- Mejuri, Catbird (jewelry brands with watches)
- Independent microbrands: Baltic, Lorier, Zelos

**Aspirational Competitors:**
- Cartier, Tiffany & Co. (high jewelry watches)
- Rolex, Omega (traditional luxury — different positioning)
